label: Simulated
sample: This is a small illustrative sample ({outer} outer rows, {inner} inner rows), not your data.

rows.real: The real plan has {n, number} rows.
rows.est: The real plan is estimated at {n, number} rows (not run for real).
rows.none: The plan does not report a row count.

stats: {cmp} key comparisons so far, {out} matching pairs.
noTime: Compared by key comparisons, not run time.
reducedNote: Reduced motion is on: each step changes at once, with no transition.
summary: {kind} on the sample: {steps} steps, {cmp} key comparisons, {out} matching pairs.

idle.nested_loop: Not run yet. Nested Loop takes each outer row and probes the inner table. Press Run or Step forward.
idle.hash_join: Not run yet. Hash Join builds a hash table from one table, then probes it from the other. Press Run or Step forward.
idle.merge_join: Not run yet. Merge Join needs both tables sorted and slides two pointers in parallel. Press Run or Step forward.

step.nl: Step {n}: take the outer row with key {key}, probe all {cmp} inner rows, {hits} matched.
step.nlMiss: Step {n}: take the outer row with key {key}, probe all {cmp} inner rows, none matched.
step.nlIndex: Step {n}: take the outer row with key {key}, look it up once in the inner index, {hits} matched.
step.nlIndexMiss: Step {n}: take the outer row with key {key}, look it up once in the inner index, none matched.
step.build: Step {n}: read the inner row with key {key} and hash it into bucket {bucket}.
step.probe: Step {n}: take the outer row with key {key}, hash it to bucket {bucket}, compare with {cmp} rows there, {hits} matched.
step.probeMiss: Step {n}: take the outer row with key {key}, hash it to bucket {bucket}, compare with {cmp} rows there, none matched.
step.mergeEq: Step {n}: both pointers sit on key {a}, one matching pair, move the inner pointer on.
step.mergeLt: Step {n}: outer key {a} is smaller than inner key {b}, move the outer pointer on.
step.mergeGt: Step {n}: outer key {a} is larger than inner key {b}, move the inner pointer on.

unsupported.noMerge: Not simulated: MySQL has no Merge Join, so there is nothing to illustrate for the {label} node.
unsupported.notJoin: Not simulated: the {label} node is not a Nested Loop, Hash Join or Merge Join.
